allowed_implementation_freedom: Internal language types, module boundaries, algorithms, and storage are unconstrained when every cited observable distinction is preserved.
Exact diagnostic wording and ordering are unconstrained unless a cited authority explicitly requires them.
non_normative_behaviors: Python object types, exception classes, module layout, and incidental algorithms are not semantic authority.
Rust crate, module, and internal type layout are not semantic authority.
required_state_distinctions: plain text constructs the exact string text
unquoted true constructs boolean true
unquoted false constructs boolean false
unquoted null constructs null
canonical positive decimal integer 42 constructs the exact mathematical integer 42
canonical negative decimal integer -42 constructs the exact mathematical integer -42

the canonical decimal scalar 18446744073709551616 constructs the exact mathematical integer 18446744073709551616 without rejection, truncation, rounding, float conversion, or string fallback caused by a 64-bit machine-width boundary
a 641-digit canonical integer remains an exact mathematical integer
a 4301-digit canonical integer remains an exact mathematical integer
a mapping root with key value constructs an exact mapping
a sequence root with two strings preserves order
duplicate constructed mapping key foo is rejected
an anchor declaration is rejected
an alias use is rejected
a merge key is rejected whether quoted or unquoted
an explicit YAML tag is rejected
a literal block scalar is rejected
an omitted mapping value is rejected
one document without markers is accepted
one document with explicit start and end markers is accepted
two YAML documents are rejected
invalid UTF-8 document bytes are rejected
a UTF-8 BOM is rejected
a carriage-return byte is rejected
plain yes constructs the string yes rather than boolean true
plain 2026-09-29 constructs an exact string rather than a date object
plain 01 constructs the string 01 rather than integer 1
plain 1.0 constructs the string 1.0 rather than a floating value
